data.title: Alphabet shares rise as Google pushes Gemini deeper into enterprise AI
data.description: Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL) shares rose 1% Thursday, outperforming a broader technology selloff, as Google Cloud highlighted the growing role of Gemini in enterprise workflows and pushed further into the increasingly competitive market for AI agents.
